main_text.p: dierum, &c. Hic vero caufa explicanda eft, propter quam Perfæ diebus decem, Hebræi autem diebus undecim genio bacchanali indulgeant. Hebræi ad menfem Adar, qui perpetuo eft 29 dierum, ex menfe Nifan adiiciunt undecim dies: quo compleatur tempus ieiunii 40 dierum: hos Perfæ imitantur, & ex menfe Diad Adar, qui ipfis eft perpetuo 30 dierum, adiiciunt decem dies, vt expleatur tempus ieiunii 40 dierum. Hinc videre licet fupplemento ieiunii refpondere dies bacchanalium: Hebræis quidem undecim, fed Perfis tantum decem. Feftu Almedgen, vel vt codex Albategnii habet, Almahregen, ait Alfraganus incidere in 16 die menfis Mahar: cum autem huic refpondeat menfis Hebræorum Tebeth, in quo Iudæi celebrant neomenia obfeffionis Hierofolymitanæ; verifimile eft, huic folennitatem Almedgen apud Perfas effe fubftitutam.

Vt autem cognofcatur, vnde principium fit æræ Perficæ refpectu anni ecclefiastici; fciendum eft anno Chrifti 632 æquinoctiū vernū incurriffe in 18 diem Martii, feriam quartam, in quam incidit Thoth Nabonafari 1380; quod ex Alfragano colligere licet, qui »a't menfes Aegyptiorum tunc refpondiffe menfibus »Perfarū, vt Thoth Nabonafari 1380 conuenerit cum »Dimeh Perfico; & poftrema dies anni fcilicet Nabonafari cc1379 inciderit in poftremam diem Adarmeh.

Quamobrem facilimū eft annos ecclefiafticos Perfarū extendere; exempli gratia, anno Chrifti 1588 incurrit Thoth Nabonafari 2337 feria fecunda, die 21 Iulii: fi ergo anni 1379 fubtrahantur ab annis 2337, remanet annus 958 Perfarū, qui refpondet anno Nabonafari 2337. page.notes: Ditto marks (») and "cc" in the left margin are rendered as printed, approximated in glyph form. Their placement is inferred from the lines beside them. Several numerals and proper names (Almedgen, Almahregen, Tebeth, Perfarū, Nabonafari) are read from a small, slightly blurred print and should be checked. The catchword "det" is read as "det" at the foot, right, after the hyphenated "respon-". Hebrew and Greek are not present on this page.
